36309: This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work.
162432: Tenka is the 6th Anti-Demon Corps Chief. She is Kyouka's friend and rival.
162524: Kyouka is the chief of the 7th Unit of the Anti-demon Corps, an elite group of women who have received power from the Peaches. She is Yuuki Wakura's savior and becomes his master after she decided to make him her slave.
170329: Caretaker of the Anti-Demon Corps 7th Unit. He attended Kaminoge High School as a third-year student but after getting caught up in a Mato Disaster, he was rescued by Kyouka Uzen and became her Slave, granting him the power to fight alongside her.
170332: Ginna Bizen is a member of the Anti-Demon Corps' 10th Unit.
170333: Aoba Wakura is the older sister of Yuuki Wakura who'd taught him about being a proper young man, but later went missing at least six years prior in a Mato Disaster
192778: Konomi Tatara is the Anti-Demon Corps' 1st Unit new Chief after the previous Chief, Riu Myouga stepped down from her position.
192780: Varvara Pilipenko is the Anti-Demon Corps' 8th Unit Chief.
192781: Yakumo Ezo is the Anti-Demon Corps' 5th Unit Chief.
192783: Ren Yamashiro is the Anti-Demon Unit Commander and 10th Unit Chief. She had an upbringing where she succeeded in anything and everything that she did, whether it was mock exams, sports competitions, or leading the student council.
192784: Fubuki Azuma is a member of the Anti-Demon Corps and is the 9th Unit's Chief. She is the mother of several daughters such as Yachiho and Himari Azuma.
266758: Maia Azuma is a member of the Azuma Family. She is a member of the Anti-Demon Corps' 9th Unit earning the position of Vice-Chief.
266759: Kuusetsu is one of the Eight Thunder Gods, consisting of the so-called Gods who rule over the Shuuki.

266762: Hattori is a student at Kaminoge High School and a classmate of Yuuki Wakura.
266763: Yumina Azuma is a Branch Family member of the Azuma Family.
266764: Takemi Azuma is a Branch Family member of the Azuma Family.

266766: A member of the Anti-Demon Corps' 5th Unit. She has become taciturn for a certain reason. She taught Himari the ability “Bam Bam Bam.”
266768: Suwa is a student at Kaminoge High School and a classmate of Yuuki Wakura.
266770: Kidoumaru is an incredibly powerful Shuuki, one of the demons that inhabits Mato. He was one of the Shuuki responsible for destroying Kyouka Uzen's home village.
266771: Sorako Azuma is a Branch Family member of the Azuma Family.
266772: Vice Commander of the 5th Unit. Highly dedicated and active in the Demon Defense Force for many years, she possesses a rare healing ability.
